title: Silent Death Messages
description: Plugin that prevents player death messages from being sent to chat, can be configured to only have certain players or permission nodes be affected.
body:
# Silent Death Messages

You can mute death messages for certain permission groups, or manually add certain players. 

## Description

Designed for server owners who want control over who's death messages get displayed. For example, if you have a jail for hackers or some death loop, you want to prevent chat from being spammed while still allowing the gameplay function to happen. This will only be a cosmetic change, where the death statistics and gameplay effects still happen but the death message is muted and not shown to players in chat.
